scope: Original accepted io_uring resource-body completion, cold resolver authority, full OFD FileWork capability, original global publication, async file/layout dependencies, completion/cancellation and source handoff.

architecture.resources: The accepted resolver retains original Files, fs/mount/namespace resources, credentials and device policy. It never borrows a current Task/Linux projection or imports an observer authority.
architecture.cold_body: Shared fast bodies remain first. Before-effect misses use the same canonical body in a scoped resolver over the original resources and caller View; no SQE metadata replay or FD re-resolution.
architecture.publication: Every context retains the original global publication. Cold rendering uses a private cache from that resource; unavailable global observation can read original publication. Numeric PID/mm bytes still need their real provider.
architecture.files: An accepted full OFD exposes only its actual FileWork data target even if other controls remain opaque. Native disk staging, PreparedOpen, mapped backing/layout waits and selected buffer leases retain the existing asynchronous path.
architecture.lifetime: Scoped restoration covers Files, source observation, private admission, reader and signal state on return/unwind. Signal readers are borrowed per operation; original SIGXFSZ delivery occurs after the resolver mutex is released. Last-close tests reject a root/Files cycle.
no_new: production unsafe block or trait override
ordinary guest memory checks or fences
